lines.x: Woof woof, arf! (Koromaru looks full of energy. It seems safe to leave the job to him.)
Wrrf! (Koromaru has fetched a bouncy ball—though it bears the infirmary's mark. Did he find it somewhere...?)
Woof woof! (Koromaru brings over a honey cake. He seems to want to share it.)
Awoo... woof, awoo...! (The weather isn't good, but Koromaru is barking at the window. It seems he wants to go for a walk even in this...)
Woof...? Woof woof, woof, woof? (Koromaru seems interested in the game board on the shelf. Perhaps next time you play, you should invite him to watch...)

Wrrf... woof! Huff huff. (Just as instructed, Koromaru has fetched a cup of instant noodles—Amiya doesn't seem to have noticed. The water has just finished boiling, too. Give Koromaru a pat on the head and praise him.)

Woof! Woof...? Woof woof. (Koromaru is standing guard at the office door. When you head out he looks like he wants to come along, but a gesture toward the doorway is enough—he sits back down obediently.)
Mrrf... (Koromaru nudges you with his head, then quietly lies down at your side.)
Woof! (Koromaru holds out a front paw. He seems to want a handshake.)
Woof...? Wrrf, woof! (Koromaru is delighted. Does he want to watch it together...?)
Woof, woof, woof woof! (Koromaru gives the others a few light barks—it sounds like a greeting.)
Woof woof! (Koromaru is thoroughly excited. All members should take care to keep up with his pace.)
Woof! (Koromaru seems to want confirmation of the destination.)
Awoo... woof woof woof! (Koromaru charges out!)
Awoo? (Koromaru seems lost in thought...)
Huff huff... (Koromaru seems to be waiting for instructions.)
Woof woof! (Koromaru reaches the designated position in a flash.)
Woof... arf! (Koromaru is very fast—but he manages to stop in time.)
Grrrrr... woof!! (Koromaru has summoned his Persona!)
Awooo—! (Koromaru seizes the initiative!)
Awoo... woof! (Koromaru lunges at the enemy!)
Wooo—arf!! (Koromaru's ferocity overwhelms the enemy!)
Awoo... (Koromaru wags his tail as if impressed.)
Woof woof, woof! (Koromaru is overjoyed—just be careful not to get knocked over.)
Woof... woof woof! (Koromaru barks after the fleeing enemy without stopping. He clearly wants to give chase.)
Woof... awooo... woof woof! (Koromaru plants himself in the enemy's path, barking without pause. He sounds truly urgent.)
Whuff... (Koromaru rolls over once on the carpet.)
Woof...! (Koromaru wags his tail happily. It seems he wants to play.)
Hmf... (Koromaru looks thoroughly content. Keep scratching under his chin.)
Arknights.

Woof woof woof, woof woof! (Koromaru trots up with a paper bag in his mouth, full of energy. Inside are a can of spray paint—the kind used to make wishes at the Reliquary—and a single coin. Did his friends ask him to deliver it?)
Woof, wrrf...? (Koromaru circles you twice. Does he want to go out for a walk?)

Woof... whuff! Woof, woof woof! (Koromaru wakes you and licks your face affectionately. From somewhere comes faint music and the voices of students, along with the sweet smell of cake... Does Koromaru want to take you there?)

Woof, woof woof! ...Woof? Woof! (Koromaru seemed so excited about the school festival that you brought him along. Perhaps he can feel the festive mood—he looks delighted. When you fetch him a slice of cake he can eat, his tail starts wagging happily.)
